SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractPassive
Base class of all passives.
Arena
The picture part of the battle screen: backdrop, the two dragons, their information boxes and short animations (attack lunge, hit blink, dodge, faint, floating numbers).
AttackContext
All information about one attack in progress.
BackgroundFactory
Draws the pixel-art backdrops of the seven battlefields.
BattleAction
What a side can do on its turn.
BattleAction.Attack
Attack with one of the three moves.
BattleAction.Rest
Skip the attack and reload shots.
BattleAction.UseItem
Use a trainer item from the bag.
BattleClock
The two game clocks: a short clock for the current turn and a total clock for each side.
BattleEngine
The rules of the game without any user interface.
BattleEngine.EndReason
Why the match ended.
BattleEngine.Outcome
The result of a finished match.
BattleEngine.Phase
The state of the match.
BattleEvent
One thing that happened in the battle.
Battlefield
The state of the battlefield during a match: the original terrain and a temporary override created by an elemental Ultimate move.
BattlefieldType
The seven battlefields.
BattleLog
Collects the events of a battle.
BattlePanel
The battle screen.
BattleSession
Connects the BattleEngine with the bot.
BotFactory
Builds a computer opponent: its deck, its items, its strategy and its favourite battlefield.
BotPlayer
A computer opponent.
BotStrategy
Strategy interface for the decisions of a computer player.
BuffItem
Raises one stat of the active dragon for a few turns.
CleanseItem
Removes Burn, Poison and all stat reductions.
CoinPack
The packs offered by the demo coin shop.
CollectionPanel
The collection screen: shows every owned dragon and lets the player fuse duplicates to raise a dragon's star level.
Combatant
A dragon during a battle: the owned dragon plus all temporary state (HP, shots, charge, modifiers, damage-over-time).
CritEffect
Raises the critical chance of the move, or guarantees a critical hit.
DamageCalculator
Pure functions of the combat formulas.
Dialogs
Pop-up messages in the style of the game.
Difficulty
Difficulty levels of the bot.
DodgeBuffEffect
Gives the user extra dodge chance for a number of its own turns.
DotEffect
Applies a damage-over-time status (Burn or Poison) to the target.
DotType
Damage-over-time statuses.
DragonClass
The seven dragon classes from the "How to Train Your Dragon" universe.
DragonDetailPanel
The full information card of one dragon: picture, class, grade, nature, stats with their IV bonus, passive skill and the three moves.
DragonRepository
The database of all dragon species, loaded from /data/dragons.csv inside the jar.
DragonSpecies
Immutable template of a dragon species: base stats, class, moves and passive.
DragonTile
A small card showing one owned dragon.
EffectFactory
Builds MoveEffect objects from the compact text used in the dragon database, for example BURN:6:2+ATK_DOWN:15.
EggPanel
The egg screen: the player pays coins, the egg shakes and cracks, and a random dragon hatches.
EventType
Kinds of things that can happen in a battle, used by the GUI to animate and play sounds.
FieldSelectPanel
The player picks two of the seven battlefields, the bot picks one, and the real battlefield is drawn from these three.
GachaService
The dragon egg: rolls a species by rarity, then the stat deviations (IV), a nature and the chance of an Alpha dragon.
GameContext
The objects shared by all screens: the dragon database, the player's profile, saving, the egg service and the sound player.
GameRules
Central place for the tunable numbers of the game.
GameWindow
The main window.
Grade
Quality grade of one rolled dragon, derived from how lucky its stat rolls (IV) were.
GreedyBotStrategy
The normal bot: uses the Ultimate as soon as it is ready, prefers Signature moves when it has shots, and rests when it has none.
GuiUtil
Small drawing helpers shared by the screens.
HealItem
Restores a percentage of the maximum HP.
HealSelfEffect
Restores a percentage of the user's maximum HP.
HowToPanel
The "how to play" screen with the rules in English.
Item
Base class of all trainer items.
ItemType
The catalogue of the five trainer items.
Main
Entry point of the game "HTTYD Dragon Battle".
MatchSetup
The choices of the player before a match.
MenuPanel
The main menu: a title, three flying dragons and the main buttons.
MessageBox
The text box at the bottom of the battle screen.
Move
An immutable description of one attack of a dragon species.
MoveEffect
Strategy interface for the extra behaviour of a move.
MoveKind
The three kinds of attack a dragon can use.
MultiHitEffect
Splits the move into several hits.
Nature
A personality trait that nudges the stats of a dragon by a few percent.
OwnedDragon
A dragon that belongs to the player: one species plus its own rolled stats (IV), nature, star level and Alpha flag.
PassiveFactory
Creates a fresh PassiveSkill object for one battle from the compact specification in the dragon database, e.g.
Passives
The concrete passive abilities.
Passives.Aura
Permanently lowers one stat of the opposing dragon.
Passives.Conductor
Gains a short Atk bonus every time the owner is hit (Skrill).
Passives.CritResist
Critical hits against the owner deal less damage.
Passives.DamageReduction
Reduces all damage the owner receives.
Passives.DamageUp
The owner deals more damage with every attack.
Passives.DebuffImmunity
Immune to reductions of one stat.
Passives.DefStack
Gains Def every time the owner is hit, up to a limit.
Passives.DodgeUp
Extra dodge chance, either permanent or only during the first turns of the battle.
Passives.FasterAttack
Flat Atk bonus when the owner is faster than the opponent.
Passives.FlatBonus
A permanent flat bonus to one stat.
Passives.LazySlumber
Heals when the previous turn did not use a Signature move (Hotburple).
Passives.LowHpDefense
Flat Def bonus while the owner has low HP.
Passives.NeverDodged
The owner's attacks can never be dodged.
Passives.NoPassive
A passive that does nothing; used when the database has no passive for a dragon.
Passives.PoisonSignature
Every Signature move of the owner also poisons the target.
Passives.ReflectAttack
Reflects a percentage of the owner's own Atk when hit by a plain attack.
Passives.ReflectDamage
Reflects a percentage of the damage received back to the attacker.
Passives.SparksJet
Gains Spd every time a Signature move is used, up to a maximum number of stacks.
Passives.SurviveOnce
Survives one lethal hit with 1 HP.
Passives.TypelessCrit
Plain attacks have a higher critical chance.
PassiveSkill
Strategy interface for the unique passive ability of a dragon.
PierceEffect
Ignores a fraction of the target's defence.
Pixels
Small helpers for drawing pixel art: scaling without blur, outlines and colour tweaks.
Player
A participant of a match: a name, a deck of three dragons in battle order and a bag of at most two trainer items.
Profile
Everything the player owns: coins, the dragon collection and the win/loss record.
RandomBotStrategy
The easy bot: mostly plain attacks, sometimes a Signature move, and it never plans.
ReloadItem
Refills Signature shots.
RetroButton
A chunky button with a flat colour, a thick dark border and a drop shadow, drawn by hand so it looks the same on every operating system.
RetroPanel
A panel with a cream face and a thick dark double border, used for text boxes and cards.
SaveManager
Saves and loads the Profile as a small text file.
ScreenPanel
Base class of the full-window screens: a dark patterned background and a title bar.
SelfBuffEffect
Raises a stat of the user, either permanently (turns < 0) or for a number of turns.
Side
The two sides of a match.
SmartBotStrategy
The hard bot: heals when low, cleanses when debuffed, reloads at the right time, saves the Ultimate for a dragon that can be knocked out or is weak to it, and picks the replacement with the best type matchup.
SoundPlayer
Plays the sound effects and the background music.
SoundPlayer.Sound
The sound effects.
SpriteFactory
Makes the pixel-art pictures of the dragons.
Stat
The four numeric stats of a dragon that can be boosted or reduced.
StatDebuffEffect
Reduces a stat of the target for a few of its turns.
StatModifier
A temporary or permanent change to one stat.
SureHitEffect
The move can never be dodged.
TeamSelectPanel
Lets the player build a team of three dragons, pick up to two trainer items and choose the bot's difficulty before a match.
Theme
Colours and fonts shared by every screen, so the whole game has one retro look.
Tier
Rarity tier of a dragon species.
TimeSource
Source of time, replaceable in unit tests.
TopUpPanel
The demo coin shop.
TypeChart
The elemental advantage table.
